content.text: In `agents` 0.23.0 and later, use `this.dynamicAgents` on your Agent. Call `await this.dynamicAgents.get(ChildClass, id)` where you used to call `subAgent()`. The other helpers have direct replacements too: `hasSubAgent()` becomes `.has()`, `listSubAgents()` becomes `.list()`, `abortSubAgent()` becomes `.abort()`, and `deleteSubAgent()` becomes `.delete()`. The old methods are marked deprecated but still work, because they just call `this.dynamicAgents`, so you can migrate gradually. I checked this against the type definitions of the installed `agents` 0.27.0.
